claim.text: The perception delay was 0.179 s, below the 0.3 s threshold.
The command delay was 0.0727 s, below the 0.1 s threshold.
The brake actuation delay was 0.14 s, below the 0.25 s threshold.
Impact occurred 1.8667 s after hazard onset.
The hazard onset reason was closing.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s, and nominal tau 0.15 s, the counterfactual still resulted in contact.
Both witness checks reported daylight lighting.
